rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted points is within the threshold.
Verifies that the latest non-projected WDI observation date meets expected freshness.

params.query: SELECT MAX(CAST(MaxDate AS INT)) AS max_year FROM stats WHERE MeasurementMethods LIKE '%WorldBank_WDI_CSV%' AND CAST(MaxDate AS INT) <= YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
